title: Latin & Ancient Greek dictionary: Wiktionary-derived edition
description:
Version 0.1.1: cache-recovery patch for the fixed Wiktionary-derived Latin and Ancient Greek reader. Data, source corrections and lexical-entry/1 are unchanged from 0.1.0-beta.1. This software/source snapshot does not itself include the large SQLite or raw-input attachments; RELEASE-MANIFEST.json identifies their exact GitHub download URLs and checksums. No new Dataset DOI is claimed for this patch.

Data and data documentation: CC BY-SA 4.0; software: AGPL-3.0-only; inherited notices retained.
